sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: This comprehensive lesson covers multiple aspects of medical-surgical nursing care.

content.content: Overview of holistic patient assessment and care planning
content.educatorActivities: Present framework for comprehensive care. Discuss importance of systematic approach.
content.learnerActivities: Listen actively, review handout, ask clarifying questions
content.materials: PowerPoint slides, comprehensive care framework handout

content.content: Accurate measurement and interpretation of vital signs including temperature, pulse, respiration, blood pressure
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate proper technique for each vital sign. Explain normal ranges and variations.
content.learnerActivities: Observe demonstration, practice on partners, record findings
content.materials: Thermometers, stethoscopes, BP cuffs, pulse oximeters
content.assessment: Practical demonstration of vital signs measurement

content.content: Systematic physical examination from head to toe including inspection, palpation, percussion, auscultation
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate systematic approach. Guide students through each body system.
content.learnerActivities: Practice assessment techniques on simulation mannequin
content.materials: Simulation mannequin, assessment checklist, examination equipment

content.content: Level of consciousness, pupil response, motor function, sensory function, reflexes
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate Glasgow Coma Scale assessment. Show pupil examination technique.
content.learnerActivities: Practice GCS scoring, assess pupil responses on partners
content.materials: Penlight, reflex hammer, GCS chart

content.content: Heart sounds, peripheral pulses, capillary refill, edema assessment, jugular venous pressure
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate auscultation of heart sounds. Show peripheral pulse assessment.
content.learnerActivities: Practice auscultation, locate and assess peripheral pulses
content.materials: Stethoscopes, cardiovascular model, assessment forms

content.content: Respiratory rate and pattern, breath sounds, oxygen saturation, chest expansion, use of accessory muscles
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate proper auscultation technique. Explain abnormal breath sounds.
content.learnerActivities: Practice respiratory assessment, identify breath sound locations
content.materials: Stethoscopes, pulse oximeters, respiratory model

content.content: Bowel sounds, abdominal palpation, assessment for distension, tenderness, masses
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate proper sequence for abdominal assessment. Explain quadrant system.
content.learnerActivities: Practice abdominal assessment on partners or mannequin
content.materials: Abdominal assessment model, diagrams

content.content: Urinary output monitoring, bladder palpation, assessment for urinary retention, catheter care
content.educatorActivities: Discuss urinary assessment techniques. Demonstrate catheter care.
content.learnerActivities: Review urinary assessment checklist, practice catheter care on model
content.materials: Catheter care supplies, urinary assessment model

content.content: Range of motion, muscle strength, gait assessment, joint examination, mobility status
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate ROM assessment. Show muscle strength grading scale.
content.learnerActivities: Practice ROM assessment on partners, grade muscle strength
content.materials: Goniometer, muscle strength grading chart

content.content: Skin color, temperature, moisture, turgor, lesions, wounds, pressure injury risk
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate skin assessment techniques. Explain Braden scale.
content.learnerActivities: Practice skin assessment, complete Braden scale on case study
content.materials: Braden scale forms, wound assessment tools

content.content: Pain location, intensity, quality, duration, aggravating and relieving factors, pain scales
content.educatorActivities: Present various pain assessment scales. Discuss comprehensive pain assessment.
content.learnerActivities: Practice using different pain scales, conduct pain assessment interview
content.materials: Pain scale charts, case scenarios

content.content: Five rights of medication administration, safe preparation, proper documentation
content.educatorActivities: Review medication safety principles. Demonstrate medication preparation.
content.learnerActivities: Practice medication calculation, prepare simulated medications
content.materials: Medication cards, calculation worksheets, preparation supplies

content.content: IV site assessment, flow rate calculation, complications recognition, IV medication administration
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate IV site assessment. Explain flow rate calculations.
content.learnerActivities: Practice IV calculations, assess IV sites on simulation arm
content.materials: IV simulation arm, IV supplies, calculation tools

content.content: Wound assessment, dressing selection, sterile technique, wound measurement, documentation
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate wound assessment and dressing change. Emphasize sterile technique.
content.learnerActivities: Practice wound measurement, perform dressing change on model
content.materials: Wound care supplies, wound models, measurement tools

content.content: Hand hygiene, standard precautions, transmission-based precautions, PPE use
content.educatorActivities: Demonstrate proper hand hygiene and PPE donning/doffing sequence.
content.learnerActivities: Practice hand hygiene technique, don and doff PPE correctly
content.materials: Hand hygiene supplies, PPE sets, UV light box
content.assessment: Hand hygiene and PPE technique check

content.content: Fall risk assessment, patient identification, medication safety, infection prevention
content.educatorActivities: Discuss patient safety principles. Present case studies of safety incidents.
content.learnerActivities: Complete fall risk assessment, analyze safety scenarios
content.materials: Fall risk assessment tools, safety case studies

content.content: Accurate and timely documentation, legal considerations, electronic health records
content.educatorActivities: Review documentation standards. Show examples of proper documentation.
content.learnerActivities: Practice documentation using case scenarios
content.materials: Documentation forms, case scenarios, EHR simulation

content.content: Assessment of learning needs, teaching strategies, evaluation of understanding
content.educatorActivities: Discuss principles of adult learning. Demonstrate teach-back method.
content.learnerActivities: Develop patient education plan, practice teach-back technique
content.materials: Patient education materials, teaching plan templates

content.content: Assessment of discharge needs, coordination of care, patient and family education
content.educatorActivities: Present discharge planning process. Discuss multidisciplinary collaboration.
content.learnerActivities: Develop discharge plan for case study patient
content.materials: Discharge planning forms, case studies

content.content: Recognition of deteriorating patient, emergency call procedures, basic life support
content.educatorActivities: Review early warning signs. Demonstrate emergency response protocol.
content.learnerActivities: Practice emergency call procedure, review BLS algorithm
content.materials: Emergency response cards, BLS algorithm posters

content.content: Patient autonomy, informed consent, confidentiality, ethical decision-making
content.educatorActivities: Present ethical principles. Facilitate discussion of ethical dilemmas.
content.learnerActivities: Analyze ethical case studies, participate in group discussion
content.materials: Ethical case studies, ethical principles handout

content.content: Cultural assessment, culturally sensitive care, working with interpreters
content.educatorActivities: Discuss cultural considerations in nursing care. Share cultural scenarios.
content.learnerActivities: Complete cultural assessment tool, role-play culturally sensitive interactions
content.materials: Cultural assessment tools, scenario cards

content.content: Team communication, role clarification, collaborative care planning
content.educatorActivities: Explain roles of healthcare team members. Demonstrate SBAR communication.
content.learnerActivities: Practice SBAR communication, participate in team simulation
content.materials: SBAR templates, team role cards

content.content: Quality indicators, incident reporting, continuous improvement processes
content.educatorActivities: Present quality improvement framework. Discuss incident reporting process.
content.learnerActivities: Analyze quality data, complete incident report for scenario
content.materials: Quality indicator data, incident report forms

content.content: Review of key concepts, clarification of questions, evaluation of learning
content.educatorActivities: Summarize main points. Answer questions. Administer evaluation.
content.learnerActivities: Ask final questions, complete evaluation form, reflect on learning
content.materials: Summary handout, evaluation forms
